The '''New Order''', also known as the '''New Empire''', was the future of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], envisioned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]. In some respects, its ideology was very similar to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' [[New Order/Legends|version]] of a New Order. For example, both Sith Lords desired to promote and enforce the absolute rule of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] through the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

As [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], Caedus intended to establish a new era throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; an era marked by peace and security, absent of large-scale war and division, under the reign of a revived [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. His vision of harmony would be protected through [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force|martial]] [[Wikipedia:Militarism|enforcement]], with the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] serving as his chief enforcers. Though the Sith Lord originally sought to corrupt his young cousin, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]], Caedus ultimately felt that he was destined to rule the galaxy with [[Tahiri Veila]] as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].

The New Order of Darth Caedus ultimately came to a premature end when Caedus was [[Battle of Uroro Station|killed]] by his sister, the [[Sword of the Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], during the [[Battle of Uroro Station|Battle]] of [[Shedu Maad]] in [[41 ABY]]. With the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Dark Lord of the Sith and the capture of his apprentice, the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] came to an end and Caedus' [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]] was dissolved.
